seoTitle: Services · Packaging sourcing, design and logistics · NOVERA
seoDescription: From specification to delivery: sourcing, design and logistics. A single partner for all your premium packaging.

hero.heading: Our services
hero.intro: We support you from end to end, from defining the brief through to delivery — a single partner for your entire packaging.

items.title: Sourcing
items.description: For every specification, we find the manufacturer that fits, including the formats and closures you won't find anywhere else. You consolidate your suppliers and gain consistency across your whole range.

items.title: Design
items.description: From technical sheets to proofs, from customization to logo placement, we settle every detail before production begins. Your first batch is already the right one.

items.title: Logistics
items.description: We handle transport, customs and delivery, and can hold buffer stock that we release on demand. You are always delivered on time, without tying up your cash.

items.title: Glass
items.description: Glass components: bottles and flacons, standard or bespoke formats.
items.imageAlt: Green glass bottle on a neutral background

items.title: Closures
items.description: Closures and stoppering systems: bartops, wood tops, screw caps, pourers, reducers.

items.title: Capsules
items.description: Shrink PVC capsules and overcaps, for a clean finish.
items.imageAlt: Bronze capsule on the neck of a dark bottle

items.title: Design & decoration
items.description: Screen printing, gilding, lacquering, customization: bespoke products true to your brand.

contact.description: A question, a brief, a quote request? Write to us — our team replies within 48 hours.
